title: fix(objectql): a runAs:'user' hook carries its user's email, so a current_user.email row policy admits it as it admits the user's own request
body:
Fixes #24639
Clause-②: no (a runtime producer change: a `runAs: 'user'` hook reads what the same user's own request reads. Nothing `@objectstack/spec` declares moves; no export is added or removed)

## What was wrong

`ScopedContext[SEED_USER_GRANTS]` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, added by PR #24518) is the second half of a hook's `runAs: 'user'` derivation. It seeded `positions` / `permissions` and `org_user_ids` from `resolveUserAuthzGrants`, and never `email`, although that same resolution returns `grants.email` (the user's stored `sys_user.email`, from the user-row read it already makes). Its early return (`if (!needsGrants && !needsPeers) return this;`) also returned a context unchanged when only its email was missing.

The RLS compiler binds `current_user.email` from the context's `email` and nothing else (`plugin-security/src/rls-compiler.ts`). So a hook fired from a hand-built `{ isSystem: true, userId, tenantId }` context (the approvals status mirror, a `runAs: 'system'` flow's writes) read nothing under a `select` policy `assignee == current_user.email`, while the same user's request read their row. It failed closed: rows hidden, never leaked.

## Measurement (real stack, before and after)

The probe is `packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-user-hook-email-owner.integration.test.ts`, beside PR #24518's `runas-user-hook-org-peers` probe and its flow twin `runas-user-email-owner`. It boots ObjectKernel, ObjectQLPlugin, driver-sql on better-sqlite3 `:memory:`, the identity objects and the real SecurityPlugin with its shipped default sets plus a fixture set whose only row scope is `assignee == current_user.email`. A `runAs: 'user'` `afterInsert` hook reads the task object through `ctx.api`, and a middleware records the context that read carries. `usr_member` and `usr_other` each hold the set and each have one task assigned to their stored email.

The probe was committed alone first (`f7366e4a5c`) and run against unchanged source at `f89d29e382`. The after column is head `841da88b8c`.

| triggering context | before: rows / hook context email | after: rows / hook context email |
|---|---|---|
| CONTROL: the member's own request (and the GUARD: the same request without its email) | `member task` (GUARD: none) | same |
| the card's shape `{ isSystem: true, userId, tenantId }` | none / absent | `member task` / the stored email |
| the request-resolved envelope, email included (control) | `member task` / verbatim | `member task` / envelope verbatim, nothing resolved |
| a carried email that differs from the stored one | `other task` / the carried one | `other task` / the carried one, verbatim |
| positions, permission sets and peer list carried, no email (the early-return case) | none / absent | `member task` / the stored email; positions, sets and peer list verbatim |

## The change

- **`ScopedContext[SEED_USER_GRANTS]` (`engine.ts`)** adds `needsEmail = !ctx.email` beside `needsGrants` / `needsPeers`, includes it in the early-return test, and seeds `email: grants.email` only when the context carries none. This is PR #24518's rule extended to the email, as triage set it:
  - a carried email is kept verbatim (on a request-resolved context, the session's);
  - a context with no `userId` is still returned untouched;
  - the email comes from the same single resolution, so a context that resolves for its grants or peers pays nothing more. There is no second read and no second resolver.
- **`SEED_USER_GRANTS`** stays a symbol the package entry does not export. No new member, export or type.
- ⛔ No backfill in `plugin-security`; `rls-compiler.ts` is untouched (ruling A′, `6261536443` item 2).

**Where the files landed vs the claim's fence.** `engine.ts` (the seed only, plus its import comment) and `hook-run-as.ts` (the seed's contract text, three docblocks) are in the fence. One file is outside it: `hook-wrappers.ts`. Its `installRunAsApi` comment carries the seed's cost contract ("a request-resolved context carries both and resolves nothing"), and its resolver-failure `warn` said every policy reading `current_user.org_user_ids` drops out. This change makes both false for a context that lacks only the email, so the comment and the warn's wording were brought in line. No logic there moves. The real-stack probe lives in `service-automation` for the reason PR #24518 gives: `objectql` cannot depend on driver-sql, plugin-auth or plugin-security.

**Cost.** A `runAs: 'user'` hook whose triggering context lacks the email now pays one `resolveUserAuthzGrants` per dispatch, as one that lacks either list already did. A request-resolved context carries an email and pays nothing, unless its user stores none (a phone-only sign-up): then every such dispatch resolves and the context still carries no email, which fails closed as before.

## Pins

- **`hook-run-as.test.ts`**, new `[#24639]` block inside the `[#24497]` one (layer 1, a real `ScopedContext` over a recording engine that answers the resolver's reads; its `sys_user` row now carries an email):
  - the hand-built shape carries the stored email, with ONE `sys_user` read;
  - a carried email stays verbatim while grants and peers are still taken;
  - a context with permissions and a peer list but no email is not returned early: it takes the email alone, the rest verbatim;
  - a context with no `userId` is returned by reference, nothing read.
- **Moved pins, two:**
  - `a context that already carries a peer list (a request-resolved one) resolves NOTHING` used `OPERATOR` plus a peer list, which is not a request-resolved context: the request path seeds an email. The fixture now carries one (a fixture that lacked a declaration, re-judged rather than re-spelled), and the pin also asserts the email stays verbatim.
  - the resolver-failure pin matched the warn's sentence `current_user.org_user_ids drops out`. It now asserts the two variables the warn names (`current_user.org_user_ids`, `current_user.email`), not a sentence.
- **The real-stack probe above** (5 cases).

## Ablation (committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`)

- **Mutation:** delete the one seeding line, `...(needsEmail && grants.email ? { email: grants.email } : {}),` (anchor 1 to 0; blob `a2c16cc04b` to `48e99778a5`). `objectql` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/objectql 'email: grants.email' --absent`: marker absent from all 14 built files.
- **Unit:** 2 red, 23 green: the hand-built shape and the early-return case (`expected undefined to be 'operator@example.test'`).
- **Integration:** 2 red, 3 green: the card's shape (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'member task' ]`) and the early-return case (`expected undefined to be 'qa-hook-member@example.test'`). The two controls and the carried-email pin stay green.
- **Restore:** blob equal to HEAD (`a2c16cc04b`), `git diff HEAD` empty, whole tree clean, rebuilt, marker present again in 4 built files. 25/25 and 5/5 green.

## Tests and gates (head `841da88b8c`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, debt held at 39 files / 233 errors / 64 signatures).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: exit 0 (0 / 0 / 0).
- objectql, the full `local` project in three shards (`--shard=1/3..3/3`): 448 files, 8451 tests passed (2738 + 2809 + 2904).
- service-automation `runas-*`, `crud-runas` and `resume-decider-identity`: 9 files, 93 tests passed.
- plugin-approvals `status-mirror-envelope` and `status-mirror-cascade` (the named producer): 2 files, 12 tests passed.
- **Derived gates** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, 72 commands): all 72 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, unbuilt packages); after a full `turbo run build` it exited 0. `check:engine-split-ratio` ran on a history deepened with `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-14 origin main`.
- `--ran`: `72 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 72 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- `test:repo` was not run locally: no test of that project is touched and the derivation names none; `Test Core` runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- **`origin/main` moved during this run** (`f89d29e382` to `bfc1539fe0`, four commits). None touches `objectql`, the hook path or the resolver; the only overlap by package is a one-line help string in `service-automation/src/builtin/try-catch-node.ts`. The branch was not merged; this PR's CI merge ref and the queue validate the joint tree.
- **The unreleased PR #24518 changeset** (`.changeset/24497-hook-runas-org-peers.md`) says a request-resolved context resolves nothing. That stays true for a user with a stored email; this PR's changeset states the email rule, and both ship in the same release. The older changeset is not edited here.
